title: Rank Math vs Yoast
description: A documentation-led comparison for choosing one SEO control center—not layering competing SEO plugins.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped Rank Math versus Yoast WordPress comparison from KreativWP.
comparisonAreas: Migration, imports, and existing SEO configuration
A pre-launch technical SEO audit after any switch
takeaway: Choose one plugin based on the team’s workflow and existing configuration, then migrate carefully. The important outcome is a complete, auditable SEO setup—not running two plugins with overlapping output.

rows.label: Free core
rows.left: Free SEO plugin with metadata and sitemap features; paid tiers extend the product.
rows.right: Free SEO plugin with metadata and sitemap features; Premium extends the product.

rows.label: Content workflow
rows.left: Module-based SEO settings and content analysis; evaluate how much configuration the editorial team needs.
rows.right: SEO/readability analysis and a guided editorial workflow; check which assistance is free versus Premium.

rows.label: Schema and paid limits
rows.left: Schema capabilities vary by feature and edition. Match the content type to the current official feature list.
rows.right: Structured-data output and additional Premium features. Check the plan for redirects and other advanced workflows.

rows.label: Changing plugins
rows.left: The directory documents imports from other SEO tools; verify migrated metadata and sitemap ownership on staging.
rows.right: Review existing metadata and available import options before replacing the current setup.

sources.label: Rank Math directory features and imports

migration: Do not leave two plugins generating competing canonical tags, titles, schema, or sitemaps. Back up, test imports on staging, and inspect the rendered source of a post, archive, and product. No ranking improvement or hands-on migration result is claimed.

decisionGuide.chooseLeft: its module and schema workflow fits your content types and the team can maintain that configuration.
decisionGuide.chooseRight: its editorial workflow fits the team, especially if you already have a working Yoast configuration.
decisionGuide.verify: Inspect metadata, canonical tags, structured data, and sitemap URLs after any change. Do not switch only because another plugin has a longer feature list.
